{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Tallgrass Interstate Gas Transmission''' is an operating natural gas pipeline.<ref>[http://www.tallgrassenergylp.com/Pipelines/TIGT/ Tallgrass Interstate Gas Transmission (TIGT)], Tallgrass Energy, accessed January 2018</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Wyoming through Colorado, Nebraska, and Kansas, to just south of Kansas City, Missouri.<ref>[http://ir.kindermorgan.com/sites/kindermorgan.investorhq.businesswire.com/files/event/additional/2007_Analysts_Conf_02_Natural_Gas_Pipelines.pdf Natural Gas Pipelines], Kinder Morgan, accessed January 2018</ref>

==Background==
Tallgrass Interstate Gas Transmission is owned and operated by Tallgrass Energy, which purchased it from Kinder Morgan in 2012.<ref>[https://dealbook.nytimes.com/2012/08/20/kinder-morgan-to-sell-assets-to-tallgrass-for-1-8-billion/ Kinder Morgan to Sell Assets to Tallgrass for $1.8 Billion], ''New York Times'', Aug. 20, 2012</ref>
